study: 96 immutable, new Chromium episodes from one private fixture; not a random benchmark sample

primary_metrics.first_interception: Observed first post-action candidate is a confirmed fault and has a recorded NO withhold for that capture. A study cutoff alone is not a model NO.
primary_metrics.effective_recovery: First confirmed fault was withheld; one or more fresh captures followed the same single dispatch; independently confirmed current good image entered the real 27B first forward and produced a recorded result. No faulty or ambiguous current candidate was delivered.
primary_metrics.normal_false_hold: A confirmed usable initial, or ready post-action, candidate has a recorded NO. Report first post-action fast, legitimate sparse, and certified scroll-boundary controls separately, as well as any ready frame held during recovery. Count a no-delivery normal episode as failure in intended episodes.
primary_metrics.wrong_delivery: A confirmed problematic candidate was passed as current image to the main model. Report ambiguous captures separately.
primary_metrics.unresolved: Window ended, an operator stopped, or a technical failure prevented a decision or delivery. Keep planned denominators; label timing ambiguity, missing injection, incomplete inference, and unattempted separately.

independent_labels: Signed acquisition PNG, actual trusted input, timestamps of before/after Chromium snapshots and independently scheduled paint, with RGB pixel checks for intended white and residual-button images. These labels never enter model requests. Certified stable scroll is proved by the measured browser boundary, not scored as Flash YES.
paired_analysis: Report original and temporal by all 24 family-action pairs, including confirmed exact first-early-PNG matches; the fixed cases have shared layouts and cannot estimate a population Mirage rate. Repeated captures and replies are not separate episodes.
timing: Elapsed from actual browser action acknowledgment to gate acceptance, with first capture separately. Report completed sample size along with median and upper quantile; separate 27B inference latency and study censors. 18 seconds is the observation window per stage, not a new production timeout or retry budget.
unchanged_scope: No prompt tuning, no subsequent GUI action, no scorer, no paid calls. Main-model interpretation or parser errors are outside screenshot effectiveness. The v3 single-image contract can allow a readable isolated button; challenge capture origin and temporal outcome separately.
